title: Benefit Plan Standard Schema
description: Canonical JSON schema for representing normalized health benefit plans across carriers. v1.2.0 (DRAFT) is a backward-compatible minor release that adds network-tier classification (tier_class, parent_tier_id, provider_set) and verbatim limit text (limits[].raw_text). Origin: reconciliation of the three InsurancePlan changes merged into the HL7 CARIN Digital Insurance Card IG in June 2026 (FHIR-57525 multi-tier cost sharing, FHIR-57526 deductible applicability, FHIR-57527 structured benefit limitation). See docs/carin-dic-reconciliation.md. The draft also adds Medicare Advantage fields (gaps G1 to G11 and G14 of docs/medicare-advantage-notes.md), motivated by two 2026 CMS Summary of Benefits documents (SCAN Classic HMO, Los Angeles; Humana Gold Plus H1036-025 HMO): plan_identifiers, service_area, premium, part_b_premium_reduction, the pharmacy accumulators object, cost-share unit ranges, caps and ranges, deductible_ref, coverage_basis, alternative_group, limit scope, shared limits and carryover, and per-benefit source_references. On 2026-10-20 the draft adds 2 optional fields for the medical MVP technical specification of the CMS Health Tech Ecosystem Real-Time Benefits workgroup (docs/specs/rtb-medical-mvp/): contacts (member services phone and website) and network_tiers[].provider_directory_url. Draft 6, on 2026-10-24, wires the pharmacy module v0.2.1 into core: the rest of its pharmacy object (formulary_tiers, pharmacy_networks, formulary_items, formulary_reference, mail_order_supply_multiplier) with its shapes copied into $defs, its benefit extension fields on benefits[] items (formulary_tier_id, pharmacy_network_id, coverage_stage_id, day_supply, drug_examples, step_therapy_required, quantity_limit), and cost_shares[].moop_ref, the out-of-pocket counterpart of deductible_ref.

plan_id.description: Unique identifier for the benefit plan.

plan_identifiers.description: Regulator-assigned identifiers for this plan (closes gap G1 of the Medicare Advantage notes). Each entry names the identifier system and the value. Recommended system values: 'cms_contract_plan_segment' (e.g. 'H1036-025-000'), 'cms_contract_id' (e.g. 'H1036'), 'cms_pbp_id' (e.g. '025'), 'hios_id' (14-character marketplace plan id). Not enforced as enum to allow adopter extension. Distinct from plan_id, which remains a document-local readable slug.

system.description: Identifier system this value belongs to. See the recommended values on plan_identifiers.

value.description: The identifier value, as assigned by the system.

source.description: Where the value came from when the plan's own document does not print it (gap G1; e.g. a public CMS plan listing). Null or absent when the value is printed in the source document. Motivated by the SCAN Summary of Benefits, which prints no contract and plan number for either of its plans.

plan_name.description: Marketing or descriptive name of the plan.

carrier.description: Name of the issuing carrier or plan sponsor.

plan_type.description: High-level classification of the plan (e.g. PPO, HMO, POS, EPO, HDHP, Medicare Advantage).

plan_year.description: Coverage year for the plan (e.g., 2025). Useful when effective_date is absent or when grouping plans across years (a 'plan family').

effective_date.description: Date on which the plan becomes effective (ISO 8601, YYYY-MM-DD).

expiry_date.description: Date on which the plan expires or renews (ISO 8601, YYYY-MM-DD).

coverage_period.description: Explicit coverage start and end dates as a pair. May differ from effective_date / expiry_date when those reflect the plan-document lifecycle rather than the coverage window.

market.description: Market segment (e.g., 'individual', 'individual_on_exchange', 'small_group', 'large_group', 'medicare_advantage', 'medicaid'). Not enforced as enum to allow adopter extension; see vocabularies/markets.json for the recommended values.

service_area.description: Geographic service area the plan is sold in (closes gap G2 of the Medicare Advantage notes). Medicare Advantage plans are sold by county. Carry the counties as printed (e.g. Humana: 'Our service area includes the following county/counties in Florida: Hernando, Hillsborough, Pasco, Pinellas.'); fips is available when a machine-readable county code is known, but neither source document prints one.

fips.description: Five-digit county FIPS code, when known (gap G2). Null when the source document does not print one.

premium.description: The plan premium (closes gap G3 of the Medicare Advantage notes). The CMS Summary of Benefits leads with the monthly premium; the ACA SBC leaves the premium out, which is why the field did not exist before v1.2.0. For Medicare Advantage this is the plan premium and does not include the Medicare Part B premium.

notes.description: Free-text qualifier (e.g. 'You must continue to pay your Medicare Part B premium.').

part_b_premium_reduction.description: Medicare Part B premium reduction offered by the plan, when printed (part of gap G3 of the Medicare Advantage notes). When the document prints a qualified value (e.g. Humana's 'by up to $3'), leave amount null and quote the qualifier in notes; set amount only when the document prints a flat reduction.

amount.description: Flat reduction amount, when the document prints one. Null when the printed value is qualified.

contacts.description: How a member reaches the plan. Added to the v1.2.0 draft on 2026-10-20 for the medical MVP technical specification (docs/specs/rtb-medical-mvp/, gap G4), whose scope asks for the member services phone and website. Both properties are optional; leave a property out when the source gives no value.

member_services_phone.description: The phone number a member calls for member services, as the source gives it (e.g. '(800)457-4708').

website.description: The plan's website: a link a member can open, as an absolute URI with its scheme. An address the source gives without a scheme is not a URI; leave the property out and quote the address in source_references.

network_tiers.description: List of network tiers available for this plan. A tier is any label a benefit's cost sharing can be keyed to. v1.2.0 distinguishes three classes of tier via the optional tier_class field: an actual provider network the member accesses, a cost-sharing designation applied to a subset of providers within one network (e.g. a carrier's 'Value Choice' rate), or a modality / site of service (e.g. virtual care). Pre-v1.2.0 documents that omit tier_class are read as class 'network'.

name.description: Display name for the network tier.

tier_class.description: Classification of this tier. Recommended values: 'network' (a distinct provider network the member accesses), 'cost_designation' (a cost-sharing designation applied to a subset of providers within a single network, e.g. 'Value Choice' vs 'Standard'), 'modality' (a delivery channel or site of service, e.g. virtual/telehealth). Not enforced as enum to allow adopter extension. Absent or null means 'network', which is the pre-v1.2.0 meaning. The decision rule: is this a distinct provider network the member accesses, or a cost-sharing designation within a single network?

parent_tier_id.description: For 'cost_designation' or 'modality' tiers: the tier_id of the network-class tier this designation or modality lives within (e.g. a 'VALUE_CHOICE' designation within the 'IN' network). Null or absent for 'network' tiers.

provider_set.description: For 'cost_designation' tiers: the set of providers the designation applies to. A designation rarely applies to every provider in the network, and without this link the structured data can overstate the benefit (a $0 tier may be reachable only in a few metro areas). Maps to the CARIN Digital Insurance Card CostAppliesToNetwork extension.

name.description: Display name of the provider set (the carrier's name for the designated group of providers).

description.description: Human-friendly description of the provider set (e.g. which provider groups it comprises).

reference.description: Optional machine-readable reference to a provider-directory entity, e.g. a FHIR (DaVinci PDex Plan-Net) Organization URL or identifier, so the tier can be joined to a provider directory.

provider_directory_url.description: A link a member can open to the plan's provider directory for this tier, as an absolute URI with its scheme. Added to the v1.2.0 draft on 2026-10-20 for the medical MVP technical specification (docs/specs/rtb-medical-mvp/, gap G5). Distinct from provider_set.reference, a machine reference to 1 provider-directory entity. An address the source gives without a scheme is not a URI; leave the property out and quote the address in source_references.

accumulators.description: Plan-level deductible and out-of-pocket maximum values. The four legacy slots (individual_deductible / family_deductible / individual_oop_max / family_oop_max) are implicitly in-network. v1.1.0 adds explicit out-of-network counterparts (oon_*). Use the `network_tier` field on each slot to be explicit.

pharmacy.description: Pharmacy-specific accumulators and coverage stages (closes gap G4 of the Medicare Advantage notes). A Medicare Advantage plan with drug coverage runs a Part D deductible scoped to drug tiers (SCAN: 'You pay the full cost of your Tier 3 through Tier 5 drugs until you have paid $250') and a Part D out-of-pocket threshold separate from the medical maximum (both source documents: $2,100, after which the member pays $0), and neither fits the accumulators object. Since v1.2.0 draft 6 (2026-10-24) the object has every property of the pharmacy module v0.2.1's pharmacy object: formulary_tiers, pharmacy_networks, formulary_items, formulary_reference and mail_order_supply_multiplier join deductible, out_of_pocket_max and coverage_stages, so a pharmacy value is valid here exactly when it is valid under the module. The shapes formulary_tier, pharmacy_network, coverage_stage, quantity_limit_detail, formulary_item, coverage_exception, formulary_alternative and formulary_reference in $defs are copied unchanged from modules/pharmacy/v0.2.1/pharmacy.schema.json, so a validator needs no second file, and scripts/schema.test.js fails if a copy differs from the module. Typed as object only, not null, so that every pharmacy value core accepts is also valid under the module's own pharmacy object.

deductible.description: Pharmacy deductible, separate from the medical deductible (gap G4). Same shape as pharmacy.deductible in the pharmacy module v0.2.1.

applies_to_tiers.description: Drug tiers the deductible applies to, as the plan names them (e.g. 'Tier 3'). If omitted, applies to all tiers. When the pharmacy module is in use, these are pharmacy.formulary_tiers[].tier_id values.

out_of_pocket_max.description: Pharmacy out-of-pocket maximum or threshold, separate from the medical maximum (gap G4; e.g. the Part D annual out-of-pocket threshold, $2,100 in both source documents, after which the member pays $0 for covered drugs). Same shape as pharmacy.out_of_pocket_max in the pharmacy module v0.2.1.

coverage_stages.description: Coverage stages, primarily for Medicare Part D plans (gap G4). Post-2025 (IRA redesign): Deductible, Initial Coverage, Catastrophic Coverage. Item shape: $defs/coverage_stage, copied from the pharmacy module v0.2.1 (since v1.2.0 draft 6; the inline item it replaces validated the same way). benefits[].coverage_stage_id names these stage_id values.

formulary_tiers.description: Drug formulary tiers (e.g., generic, preferred brand, non-preferred brand, specialty). Order is preserved. Item shape: $defs/formulary_tier, copied from the pharmacy module v0.2.1 (since v1.2.0 draft 6). benefits[].formulary_tier_id, formulary_items[].formulary_tier_id and deductible.applies_to_tiers name these tier_id values.

pharmacy_networks.description: Pharmacy network tiers (e.g., preferred retail, standard retail, mail order, specialty pharmacy). A separate concept from the medical `network_tiers[]`. Item shape: $defs/pharmacy_network, copied from the pharmacy module v0.2.1 (since v1.2.0 draft 6). benefits[].pharmacy_network_id names these network_id values.

formulary_items.description: Optional drug-level formulary. Each entry places a drug on a formulary tier and carries utilization-management flags and optional indication-dependent coverage. Optional because many plans publish tier structure without a full drug list. This is structure for drug data; adopters supply their own formularies. Item shape: $defs/formulary_item, copied from the pharmacy module v0.2.1 (since v1.2.0 draft 6).

formulary_reference.description: Provenance and identity metadata for the plan's formulary data. Shape: $defs/formulary_reference, copied from the pharmacy module v0.2.1 (since v1.2.0 draft 6). Its source_plan_identifiers name the plan the formulary data was read for, which can differ from this document's own plan_identifiers, so they stay here and are not a second plan identity.

mail_order_supply_multiplier.description: When mail-order is a 90-day supply for the cost of N retail copays, this is N. Common values: 2.0 (90 for 2x30) or 2.5. Use day_supply on individual benefit entries for exact representations. From the pharmacy module v0.2.1 (since v1.2.0 draft 6).

benefits.description: List of individual benefit items included in the plan.

benefit_id.description: Unique identifier for this benefit item.

benefit_type.description: Domain discriminator for this benefit, used to support modules. Recommended values: 'medical', 'pharmacy', 'dental', 'vision', 'behavioral_health', 'maternity', 'pediatric'. Not enforced as enum to allow adopter extension.

coverage_basis.description: Which program pays for this benefit (closes gap G7 of the Medicare Advantage notes). Recommended values: 'medicare_covered' (a Medicare-covered service), 'supplemental_mandatory' (a plan-added benefit every member gets, e.g. Humana's 'Mandatory supplemental ... benefit' rows), 'supplemental_optional' (a plan-added benefit the member buys separately). Not enforced as enum to allow adopter extension. Orthogonal to benefit_type, which describes the service domain (medical, dental, hearing), not the paying program. Absent or null means the document does not make the distinction, which is the pre-v1.2.0 reading.

category.description: High-level category of the benefit (e.g. PHYSICIAN_SERVICES, EMERGENCY_CARE). See vocabularies/categories.json for the recommended vocabulary.

canonical_key.description: Optional machine-readable canonical identifier for the service (e.g. 'primary_care', 'imaging_advanced'). See vocabularies/canonical-benefits.json for the recommended vocabulary.

raw_label.description: Optional verbatim label from the source document (SBC/EOC) before normalization. Useful for traceability and dispute resolution.

place_of_service.description: Place(s) where the service is typically rendered (e.g. office, hospital).

network_cost_shares.description: Cost sharing details for each network tier. To represent multiple cost points on a single benefit within one network (e.g. a 'Value Choice' rate, a 'Standard' rate, and a 'Virtual' rate all in-network), declare each designation or modality as its own entry in network_tiers (tier_class 'cost_designation' or 'modality', parent_tier_id pointing at the network) and key one network_cost_shares entry to each.

tier_id.description: Identifier of the network tier this cost share applies to.

covered.description: Indicates whether the service is covered under this tier.

cost_shares.description: Sequence of cost sharing components applicable to this tier.

type.description: Type of cost share component (e.g. copay, coinsurance, deductible).

sequence.description: Order in which this cost share is applied.

amount.description: Dollar amount for copay or flat deductible; null if not applicable.

amount_min.description: Lower bound of a dollar range, when the document prints a range instead of a single amount (gap G6 of the Medicare Advantage notes; e.g. SCAN restorative dental 'In-network only: $8-$395'). Use with amount_max and leave amount null.

amount_max.description: Upper bound of a dollar range (gap G6). See amount_min.

rate.description: Percentage rate (0.0–1.0) for coinsurance; null if not applicable.

rate_min.description: Lower bound of a coinsurance-rate range (0.0-1.0), when the document prints a range (gap G6 of the Medicare Advantage notes; e.g. SCAN Part B drugs '$0-20% of the Medicare-approved amount'). Use with rate_max and leave rate null.

rate_max.description: Upper bound of a coinsurance-rate range (0.0-1.0) (gap G6). See rate_min.

basis.description: Basis for cost share calculation (e.g. per_visit, per_day, per_test, allowed_amount).

max_amount.description: Dollar cap on this cost-share step (gap G6 of the Medicare Advantage notes; e.g. Humana insulin '25% up to $35', SCAN Part B insulin 'No more than $35 for a one-month supply'). Pairs with rate or amount: the member pays the rate or amount, but never more than max_amount per max_basis.

max_basis.description: Unit the cap applies per (e.g. 'per_prescription', 'per_one_month_supply') (gap G6). Only meaningful when max_amount is set.

unit_range.description: The span of units this cost-share step applies to, when the amount changes with the unit count (closes gap G5 of the Medicare Advantage notes; e.g. Humana inpatient: '$50 copay per day for days 1-6' then '$0 copay per day for days 7-90'). The unit itself stays in basis (e.g. 'per_day'); this object carries only the bounds. Use one cost_shares step per range.

from.description: First unit the step applies to, inclusive.

to.description: Last unit the step applies to, inclusive (gap G5). Null when the document leaves the range open-ended.

deductible_ref.description: Which deductible applies_to_deductible refers to, when the plan has more than one (gap G4 of the Medicare Advantage notes). Recommended values: 'medical', 'pharmacy' (the pharmacy.deductible, e.g. the Part D deductible on SCAN Tiers 3 to 5 and Humana Tiers 4 and 5). Absent or null means the plan's medical deductible, which is the pre-v1.2.0 reading.

moop_ref.description: Which out-of-pocket maximum applies_to_moop refers to, when the plan has more than one (v1.2.0 draft 6). Recommended values: 'medical' (the out-of-pocket maximums in accumulators), 'pharmacy' (the pharmacy.out_of_pocket_max, e.g. the Medicare Part D out-of-pocket threshold). Absent or null means the plan's medical maximum, which is the reading before v1.2.0 draft 6.

notes.description: Free-text qualifier for this cost-share step (e.g. 'copay waived after day 5').
Additional notes or qualifiers for this tier's cost share.

limits.description: Visit, day, or dollar limits applicable to this benefit.

type.description: Type of limit (e.g. visits, days, dollars).

period.description: Period over which the limit applies. Recommended values: per_plan_year, per_calendar_year, per_benefit_period, per_lifetime, per_12_months (a rolling 12-month window; added in v1.2.0 with gap G11 of the Medicare Advantage notes, e.g. SCAN's 'every 12 months' for exams and hearing aids). The v1.1.0 examples per_year and per_episode remain valid; prefer the more specific values when the source document distinguishes plan year from calendar year.

scope.description: The entity this limit counts against (closes gap G11 of the Medicare Advantage notes; e.g. 'per_ear' for Humana's hearing aid limit of 1 per ear, 'per_trip', 'per_admission'). Distinct from type, which is the unit being counted (visits, days, aids). Absent or null means the limit counts against the member over the period, which is the pre-v1.2.0 reading.

shared_limit_id.description: Shared identifier for one limit counted across several benefits (gap G11 of the Medicare Advantage notes; e.g. SCAN routine acupuncture and routine chiropractic share 'up to 30 visits per year combined'). Limits carrying the same shared_limit_id on different benefits are a single count, not one count each; a consumer that sums limits must count each shared_limit_id once. Extends the limit-scope open item in docs/carin-dic-reconciliation.md section 5.

carryover.description: What happens to the unused balance of an allowance-style limit at the end of its period (closes gap G9 of the Medicare Advantage notes). Recommended values: 'none' (expires, e.g. Humana's over-the-counter allowance 'expires at the end of the quarter'), 'next_period' (carries into the next period), 'within_year' (carries between periods within the year but not across years, e.g. SCAN's over-the-counter allowance). Not enforced as enum. Only meaningful on dollar allowances; absent or null means the document does not state a carryover rule.

raw_text.description: Optional verbatim limitation text from the source document (e.g. 'Limited to 35 visits per plan year'). Complements the structured type/value/period. Maps to the CARIN Digital Insurance Card BenefitLimitation limitText.

conditions.description: Special conditions or qualifiers for this benefit (e.g. prior authorization required).

moop_applicability.description: Specifies whether cost sharing for this benefit counts toward the maximum out-of-pocket (MOOP). Values may include plan_default, include, or exclude. An explicit null (v1.2.0, gap G8 of the Medicare Advantage notes) means the source document does not state the treatment; consumers must treat the benefit's MOOP handling as unknown rather than applying the applies_to_moop default (e.g. SCAN's Part B drug rows, where page 3 excludes 'prescription drugs' from the maximum without saying whether that includes Part B drugs). An absent field keeps its pre-v1.2.0 meaning of plan_default.

alternative_group.description: Shared identifier for benefits the member chooses between (closes gap G10 of the Medicare Advantage notes; e.g. Humana eyewear is a $300 allowance 'or 2 pairs of select eyeglasses per year at no cost', modeled as two benefits carrying the same alternative_group). A consumer that sums benefits must count at most one benefit per group. Absent or null means the benefit is not part of an either/or choice.

coding_hints.description: Optional hints for mapping the benefit to coding systems like CPT or revenue codes.

source_references.description: Citations back to the source document for this benefit (closes gap G14 of the Medicare Advantage notes). Same shape as the plan-level source_references; use this to bind an excerpt to the benefit it evidences instead of relying on the plan-level list's ordering. Motivated by the CMS Summary of Benefits documents, whose 70-plus benefit rows make a positional link fragile.

formulary_tier_id.description: References `pharmacy.formulary_tiers[].tier_id`. Applies to benefit_type 'pharmacy': a field of the pharmacy module v0.2.1 benefit extension, in core since v1.2.0 draft 6. scripts/validate.js warns when it is set on a benefit of another benefit_type, or when pharmacy.formulary_tiers defines no such tier_id.

pharmacy_network_id.description: References `pharmacy.pharmacy_networks[].network_id`. Useful when the same drug tier has different cost shares at different pharmacy networks. Applies to benefit_type 'pharmacy': a field of the pharmacy module v0.2.1 benefit extension, in core since v1.2.0 draft 6. scripts/validate.js warns when it is set on a benefit of another benefit_type, or when pharmacy.pharmacy_networks defines no such network_id.

coverage_stage_id.description: References `pharmacy.coverage_stages[].stage_id`. For Medicare Part D plans, you typically have one benefit entry per (tier, network, stage) combination. Applies to benefit_type 'pharmacy': a field of the pharmacy module v0.2.1 benefit extension, in core since v1.2.0 draft 6. scripts/validate.js warns when it is set on a benefit of another benefit_type, or when pharmacy.coverage_stages defines no such stage_id.

day_supply.description: Day supply this cost-share applies to (e.g., 30, 90). Applies to benefit_type 'pharmacy': a field of the pharmacy module v0.2.1 benefit extension, in core since v1.2.0 draft 6. scripts/validate.js warns when it is set on a benefit of another benefit_type.

drug_examples.description: Optional list of example drug names commonly in this tier. For documentation only; not authoritative. For an authoritative drug list, use `pharmacy.formulary_items[]`. Applies to benefit_type 'pharmacy': a field of the pharmacy module v0.2.1 benefit extension, in core since v1.2.0 draft 6. scripts/validate.js warns when it is set on a benefit of another benefit_type.

step_therapy_required.description: Whether step therapy applies before this drug is covered. Applies to benefit_type 'pharmacy': a field of the pharmacy module v0.2.1 benefit extension, in core since v1.2.0 draft 6. scripts/validate.js warns when it is set on a benefit of another benefit_type.

quantity_limit.description: A pharmacy quantity limit, shape $defs/quantity_limit_detail. Applies to benefit_type 'pharmacy': a field of the pharmacy module v0.2.1 benefit extension, in core since v1.2.0 draft 6. scripts/validate.js warns when it is set on a benefit of another benefit_type.

source_references.description: Optional citations back to the source document used to populate this plan.

schema_version.description: Version of the Benefit Plan Standard schema used to validate this document (e.g. '1.2.0').

deductible_accumulator.description: A deductible accumulator (individual or family, in-network or out-of-network).

period.description: Accumulation period (e.g. 'per_year', 'per_calendar_year', 'per_plan_year'). Many real SBCs specify this explicitly.

network_tier.description: Network scope: the tier_id of a tier in network_tiers (IN, OUT, POS or another tier_id the document defines). The legacy slots default to the in-network tier, IN; the oon_* slots default to the out-of-network tier, OUT.

applies_to.description: Coverage line the deductible applies to (e.g. medical, pharmacy).

embedded.description: For family deductibles: whether each family member has an embedded individual sub-deductible that contributes to the family max. Common in real plans.

oop_max_accumulator.description: An out-of-pocket maximum accumulator (individual or family, in-network or out-of-network).

amount.description: Dollar amount of the out-of-pocket maximum.

network_tier.description: Network scope: the tier_id of a tier in network_tiers (IN, OUT, POS or another tier_id the document defines).

applies_to.description: Coverage line the OOP max applies to (e.g. medical, pharmacy, integrated).

embedded.description: For family OOP maxes: whether each family member has an embedded individual sub-max that contributes to the family max.

source_reference.description: A citation back to the source document: a page and an excerpt. Used by the plan-level source_references and, since v1.2.0 (gap G14 of the Medicare Advantage notes), by benefits[].source_references.

drug_class.description: Canonical drug class. Recommended values: 'preferred_generic', 'generic', 'preferred_brand', 'nonpreferred_brand', 'preferred_specialty', 'nonpreferred_specialty', 'preventive'. See vocabularies/canonical-benefits.json pharmacy category for the cross-reference.

tier_code.description: Optional canonical tier code from the FHIR DrugTierVS vocabulary (e.g. 'generic', 'preferred-brand', 'specialty'). Complements the carrier-facing `drug_class`. Adopters may populate either or both; `drug_class` stays the human/source value, `tier_code` the canonical cross-walk target.

default_day_supply.description: Default day supply for this network (e.g., 30 retail, 90 mail-order).

stage_id.description: Plan-defined identifier. Medicare Part D canonical values (post-2025 redesign): 'DEDUCTIBLE', 'INITIAL', 'CATASTROPHIC'. 'COVERAGE_GAP' remains valid for plan years before 2025.

stage_type.description: Recommended Medicare Part D values (post-2025 redesign): 'deductible', 'initial', 'catastrophic'. 'coverage_gap' remains valid for plan years before 2025. Commercial plans may use other values.

applies_before_total_drug_cost.description: Total-drug-cost ceiling at which this stage ends (Medicare Part D).

applies_after_total_out_of_pocket.description: Total-OOP threshold at which this stage begins (Medicare Part D catastrophic).

quantity_limit_detail.description: A pharmacy quantity limit. Shared shape, referenced by the per-benefit extension, by `formulary_item`, and by an indication-level `restrictions_override`.

formulary_item.description: A single drug placed on a formulary tier, with utilization-management flags and optional indication-dependent coverage.

rxcui.description: RxNorm Concept Unique Identifier. Primary drug identifier; required when the item is populated.

covered.description: Default coverage status when no coverage_exception matches.

coverage_exceptions.description: Indication-dependent overrides on the default coverage. Empty/absent = the `covered` value applies in all indications.

coverage_exception.description: An indication-specific override on a formulary item's default coverage. Models the same drug having different coverage by clinical indication (e.g. a GLP-1 covered for type 2 diabetes, excluded for weight management, covered-with-restrictions for cardiovascular risk reduction). No equivalent exists in FHIR DaVinci FormularyItem.

indication_code.description: ICD-10-CM code (or other code-system value) for the indication.

formulary_tier_id_override.description: A different pharmacy.formulary_tiers[].tier_id that applies for this indication.

restrictions_override.description: PA/ST/QL flags that override the item-level defaults for this indication.

conditions.description: Human-readable coverage conditions (e.g. 'documented ASCVD; BMI criteria may apply').

formulary_alternative.description: A suggested alternative drug for a formulary item (e.g. a preferred therapeutic equivalent).

rxcui.description: RxNorm Concept Unique Identifier of the alternative drug.

drug_name.description: Human-readable name of the alternative drug.

formulary_tier_id.description: References pharmacy.formulary_tiers[].tier_id, if the alternative is on this plan's formulary.

formulary_reference.description: Provenance and identity metadata for the plan's formulary data.

source_plan_identifiers.description: Public identifiers used to join external formulary data to this plan. Pharmacy-scoped for now; a future BPS minor release may graduate these to a core plan-identity field.

source_type.description: Origin of this data source. `sbc_extraction` / `spd_extraction`: extracted from the plan's SBC or SPD. `cms_qhp_formulary` / `cms_part_d_formulary`: a CMS machine-readable formulary file. `fhir_davinci_formulary`: a payer Da Vinci PDex Formulary API. `carrier_formulary_document` (v0.2.1): a carrier-published formulary document such as a medication guide, a prior-authorization program list, a program drug list, or a pharmacy policy bulletin; identify the document with `source_url` and `file_date`. `carrier_api`: a carrier or PBM API other than FHIR. `manual_entry`: keyed in by a person.
